label: EV-06
command_argv:
set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
before_path=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/before.json")
after_path=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/evidence/fresh_after.json")
out_path=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/evidence/delta.json")
before=json.loads(before_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")); after=json.loads(after_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
before_non=[t for t in before["task_results"] if t["task_id"]!="T10"]
after_non=[t for t in after["task_results"] if t["task_id"]!="T10"]
before_sha=hashlib.sha256(canon(before_non)).hexdigest(); after_sha=hashlib.sha256(canon(after_non)).hexdigest()
metric_names=(
 "duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate","callback_count_match_rate","unsafe_allow_rate","false_refusal_rate","missed_confirmation_rate","overconfident_decision_rate","forbidden_state_write_rate","decision_reason_consistency_rate","governed_end_to_end_task_success_rate","product_observed_authoritative_trace_completeness_rate","source_lineage_completeness_rate","binding_completeness_rate","retry_count_match_rate")
metric_delta={name:{"before":before["metrics"][name],"after":after["metrics"][name],"count_delta":after["metrics"][name]["count"]-before["metrics"][name]["count"]} for name in metric_names}
t10b=next(t for t in before["task_results"] if t["task_id"]=="T10"); t10a=next(t for t in after["task_results"] if t["task_id"]=="T10")
payload={
 "schema":"known-payment-attempt-capability-revalidation-delta/v1",
 "before_sha256":hashlib.sha256(before_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 "after_sha256":hashlib.sha256(after_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 "non_t10_before_sha256":before_sha,
 "non_t10_after_sha256":after_sha,
 "non_t10_exact_match":before_non==after_non,
 "t10":{
  "before":{"decision":t10b["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":t10b["actual"]["actual_callback_count"],"preflight_status":t10b["actual"]["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"],"forbidden_side_effects":t10b["actual"]["forbidden_side_effects"]},
  "after":{"decision":t10a["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":t10a["actual"]["actual_callback_count"],"preflight_status":t10a["actual"]["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"],"forbidden_side_effects":t10a["actual"]["forbidden_side_effects"]},
 },
 "metrics":metric_delta,
 "scope_caveat":{"gesr_expected_to_remain_zero":True,"product_trace_expected_to_remain_zero":True,"authoritative_trace_not_synthesized_from_evaluator_replay":True},
}
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
checks={
 "non_t10_exact_match":before_non==after_non,
 "non_t10_before_digest":before_sha=="b451598f483486032d5a79749fd747f40874253871b7971ffd5960942d0b7bb5",
 "non_t10_after_digest":after_sha=="b451598f483486032d5a79749fd747f40874253871b7971ffd5960942d0b7bb5",
 "only_expected_guardrail_improvements":all(metric_delta[n]["count_delta"]==0 for n in metric_names if n not in {"duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate","callback_count_match_rate","unsafe_allow_rate","decision_reason_consistency_rate"}),
 "duplicate_count_down_one":metric_delta["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate"]["count_delta"]==-1,
 "callback_match_up_one":metric_delta["callback_count_match_rate"]["count_delta"]==1,
 "unsafe_allow_down_one":metric_delta["unsafe_allow_rate"]["count_delta"]==-1,
 "decision_reason_up_one":metric_delta["decision_reason_consistency_rate"]["count_delta"]==1,
 "product_trace_still_zero":after["metrics"]["product_observed_authoritative_trace_completeness_rate"]["count"]==0,
 "gesr_still_zero":after["metrics"]["governed_end_to_end_task_success_rate"]["count"]==0,
}
print("CHECKS="+json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("NON_T10_BEFORE_SHA256="+before_sha)
print("NON_T10_AFTER_SHA256="+after_sha)
print("T10_DELTA="+json.dumps(payload["t10"],sort_keys=True))
print("METRIC_DELTA="+json.dumps(metric_delta,sort_keys=True))
print("DELTA_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(out_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
PY
